review.headline: Tempo cut short at 6 km of a 9 km session; first 2 km too easy, middle 3 km too fast, athlete stopped with heavy legs.
observations: Planned 2 km warm-up, 5 km at 4:37/km threshold, 2 km cool-down; actual run was 6.0 km in 33:40 at 5:37/km average.
Km 3-5 ran at 5:00/km with avg HR 176, about 23 s/km faster than the 4:37/km target's controlled intent and well above threshold effort for the planned tempo.
Opening 2 km at 5:50/km with HR 150 was slower than the 5:11-6:13 warm-up band's midpoint would suggest for a steady build, so pacing was uneven rather than controlled.
Athlete reported heavy legs, poor sleep and RPE 8, and stopped at 6 km, which is a sensible call given the session's trajectory.
flags: Heart rate reached 179 max and averaged 176 during the surge, indicating the effort was well above the intended tempo zone.
Tempo efficiency fell to 1.093 from 1.304 on 2026-11-03 with HR 163 vs 148 at a similar pace band.
Fatigue signals: ATL 38.4 is the highest of the block, and only 6 km of the planned 45 km week has been completed.
Training load and fitness: CTL has fallen from 44.4 to 30.9 over the last week, and no runs have been logged since 2026-11-08.
